note: Mostly seasonal park - most sites are rented by the season, with about 15 kept for overnight guests. Wooded, secluded gravel sites between Sturgeon Bay and Egg Harbor, a mile west of Hwy 42; hiking trail and playground; water refill and honey-wagon service on set days. Beaches and boat launches at nearby county parks. --Claude
summary: Operator site (home, camping info, info & pictures, site map, registration form) read: 2025 rate $40 (latest posted) with $15 extra adult; 30A electric only confirmed; ~84 sites of which ~15 overnight (18%) per the colour-coded site map; 2-night minimum (3 holidays), 30-night max, phone/mail only; season May 1-mid Oct confirmed. Note rewritten as mostly seasonal.
flags: LONG-STAY: nightly share ~18% (15 overnight of ~84 on the operator's 2025 site map, no tents) - in the 10-50% band, so keep with the mostly-seasonal caveat (now in the note). Seasonal signs: 'Free winter storage with annual contract'; 'Decks permitted'; 'Reasonable annual rate'; 'Seasonal sites also available.' No wording discourages nightly guests, minimum is 2 nights (3 on holidays), no lot sales, no age limit. Iffy factors: newest posted rate is 2025 (page still also carries a '2024 Rates:' heading), cash/check only, Google 4.0 (56) - exactly at the 4.0 line, not under it. Reviewer decides.
WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. Green Bay's shore is ~650 m west, with Bay Shore Dr and a continuous strip of shoreline homes between - no coastal walk.
PIN fine: 44.9776,-87.3556 is the entrance on W Monument Point Rd; the office and loops are 50-200 m NE.

INCLUSION_EVIDENCE is accurate but add the overnight share: 'Operator monumentpointcamping.com: $40/night (2025), 30A electric, ~15 overnight of ~84 sites (rest seasonal), phone reservations -> real drive-in RV campground'.
